title: Bochner Flatness and Soliton Dynamics in Lorentzian Kähler Spacetime Geometry
summary: We study Riemann solitons and $η$-hyperbolic Ricci solitons on Bochner-flat Lorentzian Kähler spacetime manifolds. Under the Einstein field equations with cosmological constant and perfect fluid assumptions, explicit formulas for the soliton parameter are derived, yielding criteria for shrinking, steady, and expanding behaviors. Several physically relevant models, including dark fluid, stiff matter, dust, and radiation, are analyzed.
